استبدوا (form X)
# اِسْتَبَدُّوا (istabaddū) /is.ta.bad.duː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَبَدَّ (istabadda)
# اُسْتُبِدُّوا (ustubiddū) /us.tu.bid.duː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَبَدَّ (istabadda)
# اِسْتَبِدُّوا (istabiddū) /is.ta.bid.duː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَبَدَّ (istabadda)
